summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in birch-css-utils@1.0.0
details: Package birch-css-utils@1.0.0 ships a small file set (4 files) with no lifecycle scripts, no install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or secret access, no obfuscated payloads, and no destructive filesystem operations observed. No code paths that would exfiltrate data, fetch and execute remote content, relay caller data to a hardcoded third-party destination, or establish persistence are present.
